newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK gold ends sharply lower as U.S. trend continues.
newsitem.headline: HK gold ends sharply lower as U.S. trend continues.

text.p: Hong Kong gold closed at the day's low on Wednesday after selling interest in Asia, extending the decline in New York overnight, dealers said.
"The market slipped strongly in Asia today and New York overnight as the U.S. dollar surged higher," said a dealer at a local securities house.
Bullion ended at US$350.80/351.30 an ounce, down from New York's $352.90/353.40 close on Tuesday and Hong Kong's previous close of $356.70/357.20.

"Some players were staying away in view of its weakness and sentiment was generally bearish," a dealer said. "Gold is likely to continue moving down to test downside between the $350 and $348 levels. The next support is seen at $345."
Local gold ended HK$50 lower at HK$3,245 a tael.
